observations: Photo 0 shows a blue painted industrial gearbox mounted on a flat base plate with bolt holes.
A metal output shaft protrudes from the right side with a visible keyway.
A black nameplate is attached to the top but the text is not legible.
No electric motor is visible in the frame; only the gearbox housing is shown.
The item rests on bare ground; a watermark reads 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the blue gearbox housing and output shaft
no motor is visible in photo 0

risks.risk: The electric motor may be missing, broken, or not actually coupled to the gearbox.
risks.proof: a photo showing the motor attached to the gearbox and its own nameplate
risks.if_unproven: priced as gearbox only, motor not working

risks.risk: Internal gears, bearings, and oil condition cannot be assessed from the exterior.
risks.proof: a video of the output shaft turning freely by hand

risks.risk: The actual horsepower and ratio may differ from the seller's claim.
risks.proof: a legible close-up photo of the nameplate
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unspecified used gearbox

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the nameplate to confirm horsepower and ratio
Photo showing whether an electric motor is coupled to the gearbox
Video of the output shaft rotating by hand to check for seizure or broken gears
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used industrial gearbox; even with the motor and specifications unproven, it can be priced at its worst case as a gearbox only.
